dict.string: Beacon of New Beginnings needs location access to help connect you with nearby emergency services, support resources, and community assistance when you need help.
Beacon of New Beginnings uses your location to provide nearby emergency services, support resources, and community assistance when you need help.
Beacon of New Beginnings needs access to your photo library to allow you to upload profile pictures, document incidents for reporting, and share images when requesting support services.
Beacon of New Beginnings needs camera access to take photos for incident documentation, profile pictures, and when reporting issues to support services.
Beacon of New Beginnings needs microphone access to participate in live audio support group rooms where you can speak with counselors and peers.
Beacon of New Beginnings uses Face ID to securely log you back into your account without typing your password, keeping your sensitive support data private.
Beacon of New Beginnings uses analytics only to improve app stability and support features. No personal data or usage information is shared with advertisers or third parties.
